error: The page calls net revenue 'Gross revenue'; the number is net of refunds.
warning_texts: release/report.md line 7 labels the net-of-refunds headline 35,741.52 as gross revenue, so a reader takes a net figure for gross; the registry's gross for the same population is 40,235.02.
The report contradicts itself: its headline label says gross, while the caveat under it (line 8), the closing sentence (line 22) and the dashboard card say net of refunds.

Both release gates passed this page because neither reads the words next to a number: gate_release_machine binds each rendered number to its claim, and gate_release_document only checks that claim values and caveat strings are present.

In audit/check_plan.json the only document rules of this stage, claims_rendered and caveats_rendered, are listed under accepted_unproven (their plan proof failed on a missing file), so they were never shown to catch a broken release.
No machine rule at the release stage recomputes a figure or checks label meaning, so labels and wording on both surfaces were checked by this auditor alone.
metrics/calculated_metrics.json stores the gross total 40235.02 in a 'numerator' field of net_revenue, which is not a ratio; a generator bound to that role could publish gross under a net claim.
release/report.md line 11 shows the refund-rate numerator and denominator as bare counts ('27 of 57') without saying they are customers; only the caveat line above says so.
summary: All 21 rendered numbers match the registry exactly (country parts sum to 35741.52, refund rate 27/57 = 0.473684 on a paying-customers basis, caveats visible, no UNVERIFIED_CLAIM), but release/report.md line 7 labels the net-of-refunds headline CLM-NET-REVENUE as 'Gross revenue, EUR'. This contradicts its own caveat, the closing sentence and the dashboard label, and misstates the metric: gross would be 40235.02. Neither release gate reads labels, so both passed it.
